profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, focused on enterprise architecture, cloud-native systems, workflow automation, and AI-powered solutions.
profile.jobTitle: Principal Software Engineer, Technology at Epsilon
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer and Technical Lead with extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale applications, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Camunda 8, MongoDB, Kubernetes, and AWS. Proven track record leading architecture initiatives, modernizing legacy systems, and building scalable event-driven microservices that support high-volume business operations.
 
Recently focused on integrating AI and LLM technologies into enterprise development workflows and modern application platforms. Experience building AI-assisted solutions using Python, local and hosted LLMs, RAG architectures, workflow automation, and intelligent content generation systems. Actively leveraging developer AI tools including Cursor and Amazon Q to accelerate software delivery, improve code quality, streamline debugging, generate technical documentation, and enhance engineering productivity across full-stack and backend development initiatives.
 
Strong blend of hands-on engineering leadership, enterprise architecture expertise, and practical AI adoption, with a focus on scalable system design, automation, developer efficiency, and modern software engineering practices.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Technology at Epsilon
positions.description:
* Led architecture and implementation of scalable event-driven execution frameworks across multiple platforms using Kafka, Camunda, Snaplogic, Java, and Spring Boot, improving reliability and simplifying cross-service orchestration. 

* Designed and delivered core ETL capabilities, consolidating legacy execution patterns and eliminating operational complexity across distributed feed processing systems. 
 
* Drove production stability and operational excellence by resolving complex cross-system issues involving asynchronous workflows, data consistency, job lifecycle timing, and multi-tenant pipeline execution. 
 
* Built and operationalized enterprise data integration pipelines using SnapLogic, AWS, MongoDB, and cloud-based connectors supporting large-scale ingestion and processing workflows. 
 
* Served as a leader and mentor across high-impact initiatives, coordinating cross-team releases, leading security remediation efforts, modernizing shared frameworks, and mentoring teams through complex architectural and production challenges.
positions.insights: REST APIs, Shell Scripting and +33 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed and maintained high-traffic J2EE applications supporting customer-facing services and digital experiences for United.com. 
 
* Served as Technical Lead for United.com’s Vignette content management platform, managing production support, content publishing workflows, and system enhancements for enterprise web operations. 
 
* Designed and implemented a centralized web-based monitoring system for enterprise data warehouse operations, secure customer file transfers, production log access, and cross-system data validation. 
 
* Built and supported large-scale batch processing systems for MileagePlus and MyPoints.com loyalty programs, processing hundreds of encrypted customer enrollment and activity files monthly. 
 
* Optimized enterprise data mart performance using Oracle explain plans, PL/SQL tuning, and improved system design strategies, contributing to approximately $2 million in operational cost savings.
